entities.summary: Thaddeus Antonius Gerardus Maria "Geert" Reuten was a Dutch economist and politician. On behalf of the Socialist Party (SP) he was a senator in the First Chamber of the Dutch parliament from June 2007 till June 2015 and again from 26 June 2018 to 11 June 2019. Reuten also taught economics at the University of Amsterdam, and was internationally recognized as an expert on Marx and Hegel.
